question: Does the primary source chain support an object-linked disagreement over L-164 attachment support?
outcome: Five page images and four matching source hashes support the L164=1864=LTH SRG1232 identity, the individually described cord-fastened flat underside and the qualified later wooden-box group reconstruction. The 65/69 deposit counts remain unreconciled.
challenge: Later group interpretation is qualified and depends on the shared excavation assemblage and catalogue identities.
remedy: Separate object observations, group reconstructions and source dependence; restrict reviewed status to the five-page claim chain.
retry_when: Calibrated underside and edge images, or an object-specific physical review, distinguish stopper and box contacts.
